mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptides 1B, 2B, 3B, and C caused leakage from LUVs mimicking Gram-positive and Gram-negative membranes, supporting membrane permeabilization/pore formation in model bacterial membranes.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct biophysical evidence is from model liposomes, not direct intact-cell target identification.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Laurdan generalized-polarization measurements showed peptide-dependent changes in membrane fluidity in Gram-positive and Gram-negative model membranes at 5 and 30 µM.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model-membrane fluidity assay; does not alone prove a cellular molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Nile red CAC, CD spectra, and ThT assays support concentration- and membrane-environment-dependent self-assembly/oligomerization, which the paper links to antimicrobial activity and selectivity.
direct_assay_types: Nile red critical aggregation concentration assay
